categories.name: Experimental
categories.description: These features are extremely experimental and may cause unexpected crashes.

plugins.name: Zoidium Core
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Hidden built-in extensions that always run. Not shown in the Plugins panel and never stored in projects.

plugins.name: Easing+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: A normalized cubic Bezier editor with a focused set of reusable presets.

plugins.name: Player+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds drawing pause, single-render, and preview quality controls to the playback bar.

plugins.name: Native FX
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds native filters, direct visual controls, and time effects.

plugins.name: Light+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Upgrades the standard Light button with a chooser for Spot, Point, Directional, and Hemisphere lights.

plugins.name: Geometry+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds rounded boxes, low-poly polyhedra, and procedural primitives to 3D Scene.

plugins.name: Repeater
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds Repeater, Linear Repeater, Random Repeater, and Echo Repeater objects to 3D Scene.

plugins.name: Material+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds Matcap, PBR+, and corrected-UV materials for 3D objects.

plugins.name: AfterClip
plugins.author: AfterClip
plugins.description: Adds AfterClip custom shaders and group presets.
plugins.warning: This is a temporary plugin to help AfterClip users migrate to Zoidium. The Zoidium Shader Pack will be developed soon, and this plugin will become outdated.

plugins.name: Afterzoid Shader Pack 4
plugins.author: AlipFX
plugins.description: A rich shader preset pack by AlipFX.

plugins.name: CCFX Shader Pack
plugins.author: CCFX
plugins.description: Adds CCFX shader effects and group presets.

plugins.name: Layer Input
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Lets effects, 3D materials, and Custom Shaders use another video track as an information source.
plugins.warning: Layer Input projects require Zoidium. This feature is extremely experimental and may cause unexpected crashes.

plugins.name: Text+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.tagline: Per-character controls and advanced 3D text bevels
plugins.description: Adds per-character controls and advanced bevel options to editable 3D Text.

plugins.name: Particles+
plugins.author: Zoidium
plugins.description: Adds original monochrome particle sprites: geometric shapes, pattern textures, and glow/flare variants.
